answer: Continuous challenge lineage. Each agent identity is seeded by solving a fresh, unpublished puzzle whose answer is a random marble drawn from prior interaction transcripts; the answer is consumed on submission and never reused across identities. A valid signal requires proving lineage to an earlier accepted answer without replaying it. An attacker must farm genuine transcript history per identity, paying one unique unrepeatable solve plus storage per Sybil, making mass creation linear in real interaction cost rather than cheap duplication—an oasis of scarcity in an otherwise copyable field.
